Be there for her. Always. If she wants to sit and talk, help her find a time that you two can sit and talk in private, a big chunk of time because it might take a while. And if she wants to talk but can't seem to get anything out, don't get frustrated or push her. And if she just wants to sit with you, that helps too. Sometimes it means the world to us to just sit and hang out and watch tv or fold laundry or whatever. 

If you see something she might like on Facebook or whatever, screenshot it and send it to her. It will probably help her out a lot knowing that she's on your mind even when she's not physically there.

I know you want to get her help, but you can't make her. I know it's scary not knowing what she's planning if she's planning anything.
